name: kth-course-community
description: This is a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) project bootstrapped with [`create-next-app`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/cli/create-next-app).

scripts.test: bun run test:be && bun run test:fe
scripts.dev: bun run build:shared && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "bun run --filter kth-course-community-frontend dev" "bun run --filter backend-nest start:dev"
scripts.dev:fe: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter kth-course-community-frontend dev
scripts.dev:be: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter backend-nest start:dev
scripts.docker:fe:build: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter kth-course-community-frontend build
scripts.docker:be:build: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter backend-nest build
